summary: Mean now returns (0, false) for an empty slice instead of dividing by zero, and the two callers were updated to check the flag. I kept the float64 return so nothing else had to change.
how_to_verify: go test ./stats/... covers the empty, single and many cases; go run ./cmd/report </dev/null now prints "no samples" instead of panicking.
risks: Callers outside this repository that ignore the second return value will silently read 0 instead of panicking.
questions: Should Median follow the same (value, ok) shape, or return an error?
